arguments.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && vp fmt --config "$RUNNER_TEMP/pi-format.json" --disable-nested-config README.md README.zh-CN.md registry/sources.json 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "=== check ==="; vp fmt --config "$RUNNER_TEMP/pi-format.json" --disable-nested-config --check README.md README.zh-CN.md registry/sources.json 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "rc=$?"
